enriched_activities.desc: Remain asleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Turn head. Sigh. Breathe slowly. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Turn off alarm. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk to desk. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit community center, coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone call to community partner. Talk to colleague about program. Attend meeting. Take notes. Walk to printer. Pick up documents. Return to desk. Organize papers. Update program schedule on computer. Print flyers. Make coffee. Drink coffee. Answer phone. Talk to community member. File documents.
Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Throw away trash. Walk outside. Sit on bench. Check phone. Walk back to office. Enter office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working, running program sessions and meeting community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Set up room for program session. Arrange chairs. Place materials on tables. Greet participants. Start program session. Present slides. Facilitate discussion. Answer questions. End session. Clean up room. Meet with community partner. Discuss collaboration. Take notes. Return to desk. Check emails. Make phone calls. Update records. Prepare for next day. Organize files. Shut down computer.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Chop vegetables and meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower after the water-heater peak hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer to plan next day's programs and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open program planning document. Type notes. Update schedule. Save document. Close document. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Close email. Open ebook. Read book. Turn page. Close ebook. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Remain asleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn to right side. Sigh. Continue sleeping.
